video_title: How can Wemby bounce back against the Knicks in Game 2 of the NBA Finals? 🤔 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his struggles and need to play normal basketball
quotes.excerpt: It's almost like I have to play normal, not even good.
quotes.quote: It's almost like I have anything to figure out. It's almost like I have to play normal, not even good.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst and Chiney Ogwumike on the Spurs' resilience under adversity
quotes.excerpt: They were down 1-0 to Minnesota, Victor responded. They get down 2-1, they respond.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They were down 1-0 to Minnesota, Victor responded. They get down 2-1, they respond. Victor gets ejected for the elbow, they lose, Victor responds. They get down 2-1 and then 3-2 against the Thunder, respond, respond, respond. So I understand why Victor is saying that he is very confident.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Who back here expects Victor Wembanyama to respond in Game 2?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Victor Wembanyama's lack of dominant performances
quotes.excerpt: He hasn't really had a dominant performance in the last two games.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: He hasn't really had a dominant performance in the last two games. Game 7 of the conference finals, 22 and 7, that was okay. Last night, 6 for 21 from the field.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: And what they did was they loaded up boxes and elbows, they took away the pick and roll, and what they said to Julian Champagnie, you are going to have to beat us.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Knicks' defensive strategy against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: They are not going to go away from this. Darren Erman, who is their defensive specialist, was on our 2008 squad. He went to New York with Tom Thibodeau. They are going to continue to take away the paint.
quotes.quote: They are not going to go away from this. Darren Erman, who is their defensive specialist, was on our 2008 squad. He went to New York with Tom Thibodeau. They are going to continue to take away the paint and they are going to say you are going to have to beat us with tough contested twos and threes.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on the Spurs' need to prioritize transition scoring
quotes.excerpt: When you run, that allows Victor Wembanyama to get those drag screens to get downhill.
quotes.quote: They have to play to their strengths, meaning the transition buckets. If I am Mitch Johnson, I am saying you are a runner, you are an attack star, go, run. You have to, because when you run, that allows Victor Wembanyama to get those drag screens to get downhill, and that is when he is his best.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the resilience of the Spurs roster
quotes.excerpt: It is reassuring to know that these guys, the 18 guys we got, are built this way and are resilient.
quotes.quote: It is reassuring to know that these guys, the 18 guys we got, are built this way and are resilient.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Victor Wembanyama's need to adjust his positioning
quotes.excerpt: Go down inside closer to the basket. I am not talking about Wilt Chamberlain post-ups.
quotes.quote: In this situation, especially if they are going to put KAT on him out there, who he is having trouble getting by, go down inside closer to the basket. I am not talking about Wilt Chamberlain post-ups, but you know how they get him the ball on those lobs and those alley-oops, they have to bring that back into their offense.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst and Chiney Ogwumike on Victor Wembanyama's energy levels
quotes.excerpt: I felt his energy level was a little lower compared to other Game 1s.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I felt his energy level was a little lower compared to other Game 1s where he has come out and tried to establish the tone. I didn't feel he had it yesterday.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: I thought he usually when he had three or more days off, I thought he bounced back.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the physical toll of the Knicks' defense on Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Mentally he is there, but his body only can take so much.
quotes.quote: They are leaning on him, and it is taking a physical toll on him. Mentally he is there, but his body only can take so much. At times throughout the course of the game, he looks like Bambi.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Knicks' coaching staff's championship experience
quotes.excerpt: That staff that they have over there, a lot of those coaches have one championships and been in NBA Finals.
quotes.quote: That staff that they have over there, a lot of those coaches have one championships and been in NBA Finals. They know what it takes, they know how to adjust. They are going to take away his strengths.
